extDescription.message: Create tasks in TIDORA.business from Gmail, Roundcube, or any text selection on a page.

errFillSettings.message: Fill in the instance address and API key in the extension settings.

optionsHint.message: Select any text on a page (Gmail, Roundcube, anything) and choose “Create task in TIDORA from selection” from the context menu — or click the extension icon in the toolbar.

apiKeyHint.message: Generate it in the TIDORA panel: Settings → Integrations → External API → New key, with the Create tasks permission and your account assigned.

roundcubeHint.message: Enter your Roundcube address to get an extra “+ TIDORA” button in the message view (in addition to the universal selection option, which works everywhere without this).

errHostAccessDenied.message: Without access to this domain granted, the extension won't be able to connect to it.

errRoundcubeAccessDenied.message: Without access granted, the button won't appear in Roundcube.

statusRoundcubeSaved.message: Saved — refresh Roundcube to see the button.

ctxMenuSelection.message: Create task in TIDORA from selection

ctxMenuPage.message: Create task in TIDORA from this page

errConnectFailed.message: Failed to connect to the TIDORA instance ($1)

gmailButtonTitle.message: Create task in TIDORA from this message

webmailButtonTitle.message: Create task in TIDORA (from selection or this message)
